certainty_reasoning: Married, on the same per-marriage-footnoted Wikipedia article as the Gregg marriage - see gregg--wilkinson for the article's citation apparatus and why it is trusted further than Le Gallienne's.
date_label: married after the 1923 divorce; ended by her death in 1932
summary: Writer and novelist, Louis Wilkinson's second wife, married after his 1923 divorce from Frances Gregg. They had a daughter, to whom Wilkinson dedicated Seven Friends (1953). She died in 1932.

sources.quote: After his divorce from Frances, Wilkinson married Ann Reid, a writer and novelist, with whom he had another daughter, the dedicatee of Seven Friends.
sources.context: Wikipedia, 'Louis Wilkinson', 'Personal life'. The marriage is footnoted to Wilkinson's own Seven Friends (1953) dedication page and to Friedman (2002), p. 13; her death in 1932 to Malcolm Elwin, The Life of Llewelyn Powys (1946), p. 207.
sources.supports: The second marriage, the wife's identity and occupation, and the daughter.
sources.provenance: Plain-text extract of the article fetched through the MediaWiki API and read 2026-08-05; quotation sliced from that extract. Reference-marker brackets omitted as typography.
